title: ticfac Phase 0: freeze behavior and the three protocols
description: SPEC §12 Phase 0. Entirely in the ticks repository (the ticfac repository is created in Phase 1). Publish the tk --json command manifest and minimum version; make the cross-language contract bundle versioned, pinned and executable from both the Go and the TypeScript implementations already in this repo; define JobSpec/JobHandle/JobStatus/JobResult/role-result/evidence schemas (credentials included) before moving code; record current cloud routes, D1/R2 keys, image tags, worker result semantics and cleanup ordering as compatibility tests; define credential ownership and ~/.ticfacrc; define the .ticfac/ layout, checkpoint and compare-and-swap rules; encode the Appendix A lifecycle invariants as a conformance suite. No behavior change.
